Apparent magnitude test results

Inputs:
DATE = calendar date
TIME = UT
R = solar distance
Delta = Earth distance
PhAng = Phase angle
Sub-Earth = sub-Earth longitude
Sub-Sun = sub-solar longitude
H_Ecl_Long = heliocentric ecliptic longitude
Sub-Lat = planetocentric sub-latitude (Saturn)
Sub-Lat = planetographic sub-latitude (Uranus)

Outputs:
AP_MAG = apparent magnitude computed here
PRE_AP_MAG = pre-determined apparent magnitude
DEL_AP_MAG = AP_MAG - PRE_AP_MAG
